name: kernel_frame_tool_runner
chronology: The initial six integration tests and an abbreviated descriptor preceded production implementation; their RED is an API compile failure only. Additional regressions and canonical descriptor fields were added during review after implementation. No full historical behavioral TDD claim is made.
input: Sealed frame binding, explicit issuer, token and bounded readonly call
output: Consumed frame-bound permit and verified CAS ToolResultRef

test_list.description: Actual file bytes and truncation metadata are persisted and verified through the real CAS.
Reject mismatched signed token, configured issuer, execution frame and issuing runner.
An exact directory grant never implies descendant access.
Outstanding permits are rechecked against the runner revocation ledger.
Require visible references and reject output beyond the hard caller envelope cap.
Reject unknown fields, mutable operations, path escape and closed owners.
Pure queries require ExecuteTool on their own namespace and cannot read files.
Resolve only visible, capability-authorized shortrefs without broadening exact CAS rights.
Reject cancelled, oversized or zero-cap invocations before execution.
Retain truncated=true when a read limit omits real source bytes.
Property-check exact escaped JSON bytes or failure at arbitrary output caps.
Use the real clock and reject expired credentials or foreign kernel roots.
Recall filters the actual owner session before exposing records.
Kernel shutdown waits until detached blocking inspection ownership is released.
The global 64-slot bound holds and shutdown wakes waiting admissions.
Persistent CAS/history reads cannot exploit a catalog PURE classification to bypass pure-only role restrictions.

inputs.name: binding
inputs.description: Sealed actual frame, role, root and token witness.

inputs.name: issuer
inputs.description: Explicit trusted capability authority public key.

inputs.name: call
inputs.description: Untrusted bounded readonly or pure builtin request.

output_description: Single-use frame-bound permit, then an actual bounded CAS-persisted result with verified readback.
limits: No mutation dispatch, no filesystem preemption or race-free hostile-filesystem claim
